topics: Review of Diodes  – Diode circuits – Wave shaping circuits – Rectifiers -
Clippers – clampers, Zener diodes – Zener voltage regulators
Introduction to BJT  – BJT Operation- BJT Terminal Voltages and transistor currents – BJT voltage and current amplification – BJT Switching
BJT Biasing  – DC load line and Bias Point- Biasing circuits - fixed bias
voltage divider bias, role of emitter resistance in bias stabilization
Stability factor (derivation of stability factors for voltage divider biasing only) - Numerical problems
Introduction to Amplifiers  – BJT amplifier configurations – -Amplifier classifications
RC Coupled Amplifier  – AC load line concepts – Small signal low frequency ac equivalent circuit of CE amplifier –Role of coupling capacitors and emitter bypass capacitor
Calculation of amplifier gains and impedances using h parameter equivalent circuit
Introduction to FET  - JFET common drain amplifier-Analysis of common drain amplifier using voltage divider biasing
Multistage amplifiers : Direct, RC, transformer coupled amplifiers
Feedback in amplifiers  – Feedback topologies - Effect of positive and negative feedbacks

Oscillators : Barkhausen’s criterion– RC oscillators (RC Phase shift  oscillator and Wein Bridge oscillator) –LC oscillators (Hartley and Colpitt’s) – Expression of frequency of oscillations- Crystal oscillator
Operational Amplifiers : Block diagram of Op-Amp
Properties of ideal and practical Op-amps - Gain, CMRR and Slew rate
Open loop and Closed loop Configurations - concept of virtual ground -
Negative feedback in Op-amps
Inverting and non- inverting amplifier circuits
Summing and difference amplifiers, Instrumentation amplifier
OP-AMP Circuits : Differentiator and Integrator circuits-practical circuits
Comparators: Zero crossing and voltage level detectors, Schmitt trigger
Wave form generation using Op-Amps: Square, triangular and ramp generator circuits using Op-Amp- Effect of slew rate on waveform generation
Timer 555 IC : Internal diagram of 555IC–Astable and Monostable multi-vibrators using 555 IC

Design amplifier and oscillator circuits using BJT
Explain the basic concepts of Operational amplifier (OPAMP)
Design and develop various OPAMP application circuits.
